<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Filament\Concerns;

use Filament\Resources\Resource;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Support\Htmlable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

/**
 * Breadcrumb "solo record" per le list page nidificate: mostra la label della
 * risorsa radice (link al suo indice) seguita dai soli titoli dei record
 * antenati (gruppo, categoria, …). Omette le label delle risorse intermedie e
 * il "Lista" finale della pagina.
 *
 * Es. lista tag di "Colore" in "Tag prodotto": Tag anagrafiche / Tag prodotto / Colore
 *
 * @mixin \Filament\Resources\Pages\ListRecords
 */
trait HasRecordOnlyBreadcrumbs
{
    /**
     * @return array<string>
     */
    public function getBreadcrumbs(): array
    {
        /** @var class-string<Resource> $resource */
        $resource = static::getResource();
        $registration = $resource::getParentResourceRegistration();
        $record = $this->getParentRecord();

        // antenati [resourceClass, record] dal padre immediato risalendo
        /** @var list<array{class-string<Resource>, Model}> $ancestors */
        $ancestors = [];

        while ($registration && $record instanceof Model) {
            /** @var class-string<Resource> $parentResource */
            $parentResource = $registration->getParentResource();
            $ancestors[] = [$parentResource, $record];

            $registration = $parentResource::getParentResourceRegistration();
            $related = $registration ? $record->{$registration->getInverseRelationshipName()} : null;
            $record = $related instanceof Model ? $related : null;
        }

        // pagina top-level (nessun parent): solo la label della risorsa
        if ($ancestors === []) {
            return [$resource::getBreadcrumb()];
        }

        // dalla radice al padre immediato
        $ancestors = array_reverse($ancestors);

        [$rootResource] = $ancestors[0];

        $rootUrl = $rootResource::getUrl('index', shouldGuessMissingParameters: true);

        $breadcrumbs = [
            $rootUrl => $rootResource::getBreadcrumb(),
        ];

        $lastAncestor = array_key_last($ancestors);

        foreach ($ancestors as $index => [$ancestorResource, $ancestorRecord]) {
            $title = $ancestorResource::getRecordTitle($ancestorRecord);
            $label = $title instanceof Htmlable ? $title->toHtml() : (string) $title;

            // il padre immediato è cliccabile: porta alla sua lista (i record
            // fratelli). Il parametro del nonno è risolto dalla route corrente.
            // Se però la sua lista coincide con il root (nidificazione a un solo
            // livello) resta testo semplice, per non sovrascrivere il root.
            $url = $index === $lastAncestor
                ? $ancestorResource::getUrl('index', shouldGuessMissingParameters: true)
                : null;

            if ($url !== null && $url !== $rootUrl) {
                $breadcrumbs[$url] = $label;
            } else {
                $breadcrumbs[] = $label;
            }
        }

        return $breadcrumbs;
    }

    /**
     * Titolo pagina: ultimo livello delle breadcrumb (titolo del record padre
     * immediato, es. "Colore"). Sulle pagine top-level ricade sulla label della
     * risorsa.
     */
    public function getTitle(): string
    {
        $breadcrumbs = $this->getBreadcrumbs();

        return (string) end($breadcrumbs);
    }
}

namespace App\Filament\Resources\Products\Pages;

use App\Filament\Resources\Category1s\Category1Resource;
use App\Filament\Resources\Category2s\Category2Resource;
use App\Filament\Resources\Products\ProductResource;
use App\Models\Category2;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Filament\Concerns\IsDigitalHubListPage;
use Filament\Resources\Pages\ListRecords;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\Relation;
use Override;

class ListProducts extends ListRecords
{
    use IsDigitalHubListPage;

    protected static string $resource = ProductResource::class;

    /**
     * @return Builder<\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model>|Relation<\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model, \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model, *>|null
     */
    #[Override]
    protected function getTableQuery(): Builder|Relation|null
    {
        $query = parent::getTableQuery();
        $category2Id = request()->query('category_2');

        if ($query !== null && is_string($category2Id) && $category2Id !== '') {
            $query->where('category_2_id', (int) $category2Id);
        }

        return $query;
    }

    /** @return array<string|int, string> */
    #[Override]
    public function getBreadcrumbs(): array
    {
        $category2Id = request()->query('category_2');
        if (! is_string($category2Id) || $category2Id === '') {
            return parent::getBreadcrumbs();
        }

        $category2 = Category2::query()->with('category1')->find((int) $category2Id);
        if ($category2 === null) {
            return parent::getBreadcrumbs();
        }

        $crumbs = [Category1Resource::getUrl('index') => __('category1.model_plural')];

        if ($category2->category1 !== null) {
            $crumbs[Category2Resource::getUrl('index', ['category_1' => $category2->category1->id])] = $category2->category1->name;
        }

        $crumbs['#'] = $category2->name;
        $crumbs[] = __('product.model_plural');

        return $crumbs;
    }


}
